Government. Transcended.

iac_philosophy.principle: Everything is code: versioned, reproducible, and automated

requirements: Fail fast on security or quality gates

container_architecture.healthchecks: Every container exposes a /health endpoint; readiness/liveness probes on K8s
container_architecture.resource_limits: CPU/memory precisely defined, with autoscaling enabled
container_architecture.security: Distroless base images, vulnerability scanning, signed images

kubernetes.deployment: Multi-AZ, anti-affinity, rolling updates, strict RBAC, Istio mTLS, automated scaling
kubernetes.monitoring: Prometheus and Grafana for full telemetry; every metric matters
kubernetes.networking: Service mesh with Istio, network policies for micro-segmentation
kubernetes.storage: Persistent volumes with encryption at rest

security.model: Zero-trust, mTLS everywhere, network micro-segmentation, Vault-integrated secrets, mandatory audit logging
security.testing: Automated SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, quarterly pen tests
security.compliance: FISMA High, NIST 800-53, Section 508, WCAG 2.1 AA
security.encryption: TLS 1.3 minimum, encryption at rest and in transit

database.ha: Multi-AZ with daily encrypted backups, point-in-time restore, automated failover
database.compliance: Audit trails on all DML, role-based access control, retention policies
database.performance: Connection pooling, query optimization, performance insights

observability.alerting: Critical alerts escalate to ops with PagerDuty integration

deployment_strategy: Progressive (canary) with auto-analysis, instant rollback, traffic splitting (Argo Rollouts)
quality_standards: No compromises: four nines uptime, championship test coverage, measured business outcomes
Every deployment is observable, reversible, and forensically logged
Continuous improvement through metrics and feedback loops
